items.text: The process that loads this table has not been found anywhere in the available files. The table itself has no field recording which system wrote each row

This table's staging table has a similar structure to two other tables. One matches closely and shares a name pattern with a known payroll source, but has not been updated since October 2025, ruling it out as the current source. The other is an even closer match and is still live and current: the more plausible current source, though not confirmed by any loading code

That live candidate table carries a field tied to the same unresolved lookup concept that the scenario dimension's own loading process tries and fails to match against. This is useful supporting evidence for that dimension's own open question, though not a full resolution
A second candidate table, tied to a different source tag for operational forecasting, was checked and ruled out: its columns describe order-picking productivity, not labor budget dollars and hours
Every scenario value used in this table resolves cleanly against the scenario dimension's own confirmed rows. No invalid keys and no duplicate records were found across all rows
